note: REAL captured frame (windows-session-01.pcap frame 5580, t=109.503s): the FIRST report Cortex Control 4.0.1 sends on connect - ResetCommsBuffers with request_id=0 and a fresh 32-hex session_id. The device echoes the session_id back. This is a session hello, NOT an unlock (the device stalls every SET_REPORT status stage regardless, while still processing the report).
